en: Kukuku... Don't be in such a hurry.
The fun's only just starting.
Playing it cool, are you? ...You make me sick.

jp: そっちは随分とヤバそうだなぁ
とくにそこの白羽根の坊主
en: Kukuku. You lot look to be in a bad way. Especially that white-winged kid there.
He's gone white as a sheet.
Cain!?
I-I'm fine... My wings, a little... Ugh!!
Hey! Don't push yourself!
I-I'm fine... I can still fight!

jp: またしっぽを巻いて逃げるか？
en: So what'll it be? Tuck your tails and run again?
Like hell!!

jp: くっくっくっくっ・・・
いいぜ、どうせ殺すなら
こいつで遊んでやるよ
en: Kukukuku... Fine. If I'm killing you anyway, I'll play with you using this.

jp: ペインリングを使うつもりだ！
en: This is bad! He means to use the Pain Ring!

jp: くっくっくっ・・・死ね！！
en: Kukuku... Die!!
That's enough!!!
Gwaaaah!!
What the hell is this!?

jp: お前のペインリングの力、
一時的にだが封じさせてもらう
en: Your Pain Ring's power... I shall seal it, if only for a time.

jp: アンタは、悪魔討伐隊の・・・
en: You're... from the demon-hunting squad... What are you doing here!?

jp: その討伐が私の役目だ
en: Demons driven mad by the Thirst. Hunting them down is my duty.

jp: 敵がそこにいるかぎり
en: Wherever the enemy is, that is where I go.

jp: 教団の犬が、ふざけやがって！！
en: ...Tch! Damn Church dog, screwing with me!!

jp: 本当に生きていたとはな
en: I had heard the rumors, but to think you truly lived.
......Tch. You again, six-wing.
That six-winged angel... it can't be!!

jp: マティアをさらった天使か！？
en: The angel who took Matia!?
Brother!?
D-did she say brother!?
...Syria? ...Why are you here?

jp: この人数相手は面倒か
en: Without the Pain Ring, this many is going to be a pain.
...No choice. I'll pull back for now!
You can still fight, can't you?

jp: やりたいなら一人でやりな
もっとも、力の無駄遣いしても
en: Do it alone if you want. That is, if you don't mind wasting your power.
Wait!!

jp: それまで勝手に死ぬなよ
en: ......Hmph. I'm the one who kills you. Don't go dying on me before then.

jp: 魔力封じの効果は短い！！
en: After him!! The magic seal won't last long!!

jp: ですが、この悪魔たちは！？
en: But sir, what about these demons!?
Ignore the small fry!! Aragi takes priority!!
Sir!!
Brother...
Syria...

jp: お前が教団に離反したのは
何故、そのような愚行を・・？
en: I know you turned your back on the Church. Why commit such folly...?

jp: 間違っているからです！！
en: Because the Church... is wrong!!

jp: お兄様は知らないのですか！？
捕らわれた子供たちのことを！！
en: Don't you know, Brother!? About the children they've imprisoned!!

jp: リリスや、小さな子供たちが
どんな目にあっているのか
お兄様は知らないのですか！？
en: Lilis, and all those little children... Don't you know what's being done to them!?

jp: だが、全ては大義のため
en: ....I know. But it is all for the greater cause. A worthy sacrifice.

jp: 幼い命を踏み台にすることが
en: Trampling young lives underfoot... that's your greater cause?

jp: 誰かを犠牲にすることも
許されてしまうのですか？
en: For the cause, is it permitted to sacrifice anyone at all?

jp: 血の生けにえを求めるように
en: Since when did angels start demanding blood sacrifices!!
...Heh.
You haven't changed at all since that day.
What are you doing!! We'll lose him!!
Yes. I'm coming.
Brother...

jp: 教団に戻ることも出来る
en: If you come now, I can arrange for your return to the Church.

jp: 引き返さないというなら
もうお前は私の妹ではない
en: But if you will not turn back, then you are no longer my sister.

jp: 討つべき異端者の一人だ
en: Only one more heretic to be struck down.
I was prepared for that from the day I left the Church.
...I see. Then so be it.
Farewell.
The next time we meet, we meet as enemies.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
